applications.name: AMD Vivado Design Suite
applications.summary: AMD's integrated FPGA and adaptive-SoC development environment for design entry, synthesis, implementation/place-and-route and verification on supported AMD devices.
applications.license: Proprietary AMD EULA; device and feature access is controlled by the selected license tier.
applications.platform_notes: Vivado 2026.2 supports Windows 11 24H2/25H2 and selected 64-bit Linux distributions. Check the release-specific OS matrix before installing; macOS is not listed as a supported host for the current release.
applications.pricing_notes: Starting with 2026.1, BASIC is a $0 annual tier with renewal; CORE and PRO are annual subscription tiers; ENTERPRISE and GOLD are perpetual tiers. Device coverage and features vary by tier; confirm current prices and target-device eligibility with AMD.
features: Integrated design entry and RTL synthesis
FPGA implementation including placement and routing
Verification and simulation tools in the design environment
Support for AMD FPGAs and adaptive SoCs including Versal families
Selectable device families and tool components during installation
strengths: Integrated vendor-supported flow for AMD FPGA and adaptive-SoC devices
Current 2026.2 release includes new device support and implementation improvements
Tiered licensing includes a free entry-level BASIC option for eligible devices
limitations: Proprietary and tied to AMD device families
License tiers differ in supported devices and features; the free BASIC tier is not equivalent to full-featured tiers
Large toolchain and device packages require substantial storage and compatible host OS versions

recommendation.pick_for: Choose Vivado when the target is an AMD FPGA or adaptive SoC and you need AMD's integrated synthesis, implementation and verification flow.
recommendation.compare_when: Compare the exact license tier and device support before committing; consider Quartus for Altera devices or an open-source flow only when the target architecture is supported.

maintenance.note: AMD's official product page identifies Vivado 2026.2 as available; the 2026.2 release and supported-OS documentation were published on 2026-11-11.

applications.name: Altera Quartus Prime Lite Edition
applications.summary: Free entry-level edition of the Altera Quartus Prime FPGA design suite for selected devices, providing essential design tools and a basic compile flow.
applications.license: Proprietary Altera software terms; Lite Edition is a free download and does not require a license file.
applications.platform_notes: Altera's 25.3 installation documentation dated 2026-10-19 describes Windows and Linux installation. Exact supported OS versions and device files vary by release; consult the current Altera OS and device-support matrices.
applications.pricing_notes: Lite Edition is free and does not require a license file. Standard and Pro are separate paid editions; Pro has a limited free mode for Cyclone 10 GX only. Edition features and device support are not interchangeable.
features: Integrated FPGA design environment for design entry, synthesis, optimization and verification
Basic compile flow and essential design tools in the Lite edition
Starter simulation and Signal Tap support as listed on the current product page
Selected high-volume Altera FPGA and CPLD device families
strengths: No-cost entry point for supported Altera devices
No license-file setup is required for the Lite edition
Vendor-aligned design and compile workflow for Altera FPGA hardware
limitations: Lite supports selected devices and a limited feature set compared with Standard and Pro
High-end device families and advanced features may require another edition
Check the exact device-support table and OS matrix for the release being installed; the current Pro release number must not be assumed to apply to Lite

recommendation.pick_for: Choose Quartus Prime Lite when your target is explicitly supported by the Lite device matrix and you want a free Altera design environment.
recommendation.compare_when: Compare Standard or Pro only if the required device family or feature is excluded from Lite; compare Vivado for AMD devices and open-source tools only for supported architectures.

maintenance.note: Altera's current product page lists Lite alongside Standard and Pro; its Quartus Prime 25.3 installation and licensing documentation was updated on 2026-10-19. The latest Lite-specific release number was not independently confirmed.
